# Local browser dependencies

`jsQR-1.4.0.js` is the unmodified browser build of jsQR 1.4.0.
It decodes camera frames and uploaded QR images locally; no camera frames
are sent to third-party services. The pinned copy avoids a runtime CDN dependency.

- Project: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js
- License: Apache-2.0, included as `jsQR-LICENSE`
- SHA-256: `bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859`
